title: cnidium bhutanicum
intro: Cnidium bhutanicum, commonly known as She Chuang Zi, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Cnidium bhutanicum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant effects, which help to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Cnidium bhutanicum include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
